prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square reaction-meme image of a chubby yellow cartoon giraffe having an absurdly intense belly laugh, in the style of a slightly blurry screenshot from playful 3D animation. Give it an oversized, soft, rounded head, a broad bulging muzzle, tiny nostrils, inflated cheeks, a pear-shaped belly, and stubby arms held beside its chest. Its thick, elongated neck, two short brown-tipped ossicones, sideways ears, and scattered caramel-brown patches clearly identify it as a giraffe. Keep the skin smooth and golden yellow, with a pale cream belly. The laugh is the entire focus: head tipped backward, eyes squeezed shut into tiny upward arches, and an enormous open mouth stretching across almost the whole lower face, with deeply raised corners, a dark interior, a simple white upper tooth band, and a visible pink tongue. Its shoulders are lifted and its belly pushes forward as though its whole body is shaking with laughter. The expression should be goofy, smugly delighted, and contagiously ridiculous. Use soft rounded forms, warm lighting, saturated colors, and a blurred green background. Frame closely enough that the face dominates while the giraffe’s neck and round torso remain visible. No text or watermark.
